nodes.label: Product Editor
nodes.description: Full-stack print-file generator for Printo.in. Customers upload and compose photos; system renders 300-DPI print files and delivers via webhook or direct download.

nodes.label: Printo.in Storefront
nodes.description: The external storefront that embeds the Product Editor via iframe and receives rendered print files via signed HMAC webhook.

nodes.label: Django Backend
nodes.description: Django 5 + DRF backend serving REST API, running Gunicorn, with Celery for async task processing.

nodes.label: Next.js Frontend
nodes.description: Next.js 16 App Router frontend providing the interactive canvas editor, dashboard, and embed iframe.

nodes.label: Celery Worker
nodes.description: Async worker pool (priority + standard queues) that renders 300-DPI PNG/PDF files from canvas state.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: Redis 7 used as Celery broker (db0), result backend, and status-polling cache (db1) with allkeys-lru eviction.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 16 database storing API keys, render jobs, canvas data, embed sessions, and uploaded files.

nodes.label: nginx Edge Proxy
nodes.description: nginx 1.27 edge proxy handling TLS termination via Cloudflare Origin Certificate and routing to backend/frontend.

nodes.label: Fabric.js Canvas
nodes.description: Fabric.js 7.2 library used for interactive canvas editing, lazy-loaded via next/dynamic.

nodes.label: Pillow Renderer
nodes.description: Pillow-based high-res PNG/PDF renderer in layout_engine/engine.py that composites images at 300 DPI.

nodes.label: Layout Engine
nodes.description: backend/django/layout_engine/engine.py - Pillow-based renderer applying per-frame transforms, smart downscaling, and paper masks.

nodes.label: Embed Session
nodes.description: Short-lived token model tying an order_id and callback_url to an API key for the storefront embed iframe flow.

nodes.label: CanvasData
nodes.description: Django model storing per-(order_id, api_key) canvas state JSON including frames, overlays, and calendar data.

nodes.label: RenderJob
nodes.description: Django model tracking async render task status, retry count, and output file references.

nodes.label: render_canvas_task
nodes.description: Celery task that extracts frame transforms from CanvasData.editor_state and calls LayoutEngine to produce 300 DPI output.

nodes.label: notify_caller_webhook_task
nodes.description: Separate Celery task that POSTs HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook payload to EmbedSession.callback_url on render completion.

nodes.label: garbage_collector_task
nodes.description: Daily Celery task (02:00 UTC) that deletes expired export files, skipping files tied to manual-review orders.

nodes.label: Chunked Upload API
nodes.description: Three-step upload API: POST /upload/init, PUT /upload/{id}/chunk, POST /upload/{id}/complete for multi-file uploads.

nodes.label: Embed Proxy
nodes.description: Next.js route at /api/embed/proxy that resolves embed token to apiKey+orderId, enforces path allowlist, injects X-Order-ID header.

nodes.label: Internal Proxy
nodes.description: Next.js server-side proxy at /api/internal/proxy gated by NextAuth session cookie, preventing API key exposure to browser.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Webhook
nodes.description: Signed webhook POSTed to callback_url with X-Signature header; caller verifies using api_key as shared secret.

nodes.label: Overlay Renderer
nodes.description: services/overlay_renderer.py draws text/shape/image overlays onto the canvas via Pillow ImageDraw.

nodes.label: Calendar Feature
nodes.description: Calendar primitive for layout system: a positioned date-grid region authored by ops and overridden per-cell by customers with text/image/hide.

nodes.label: Calendar Renderer
nodes.description: services/calendar_renderer.py draws month grid, weekday header, and per-cell overrides at 300 DPI.

nodes.label: CalendarState
nodes.description: Per-canvas calendar override stored in CanvasData.editor_state.calendar: year, month, and per-ISO-date cell overrides.

nodes.label: Fonts Service
nodes.description: services/fonts.py caches PIL.ImageFont for bundled Inter-Variable.ttf; serves any weight from single variable font file.

nodes.label: Inter Variable Font
nodes.description: Inter Variable TTF (Apache 2.0 / SIL OFL) bundled in services/fonts_assets/; single font for all server-side text rendering.

nodes.label: APIKey
nodes.description: Django model for bearer token auth with per-key permission flags: can_generate_layouts, can_access_exports, is_ops_team.

nodes.label: EditorRenderView
nodes.description: POST /api/editor/render endpoint that accepts canvas payload, creates CanvasData+RenderJob, dispatches render_canvas_task.

nodes.label: PIA Auth
nodes.description: External auth service at PIA_API_BASE_URL providing JWT tokens; NextAuth Credentials provider wraps it with refresh support.

nodes.label: Service Worker
nodes.description: public/sw.js - cache-first Service Worker for /_next/static/* and /static/*; registered production-only after window.load.

nodes.label: IndexedDB File Store
nodes.description: src/lib/file-store.ts - IndexedDB-backed File persistence keyed by (orderId, fileId) for page-refresh recovery of original Files.

nodes.label: MediaPipe Auto-Orientation
nodes.description: POST /api/orientation/detect runs BlazePose on uploaded files to detect rotation; returns rotation+confidence for auto-correction.

nodes.label: Smart Crop
nodes.description: calculateSmartCropOffsets clamps crop offsets to frame pan room; IDB-cached; reused for calendar cell images.

nodes.label: STORAGE_ROOT
nodes.description: Single env-driven base path for all file storage: layouts, exports, uploads, calendar palettes, holidays, fonts.json, sku_layouts.json.

nodes.label: SKU→Layout Mapping
nodes.description: storage/sku_layouts.json maps product SKUs to layout names; served by GET/PUT /api/sku-layouts/ endpoint.

nodes.label: AI Development Guardrails
nodes.description: Development rules: no AI image processing re-introduction, multi-surface support, strict TypeScript, path safety, Celery retry discipline, isExport flag.

nodes.label: Celery Beat Scheduler
nodes.description: Celery Beat container running periodic tasks; does NOT run DB migrations (only Gunicorn container does).

nodes.label: Calendar Layout Service
nodes.description: services/calendar_layout.py::materialize_surfaces() expands a single calendar template into 12 per-month surface dicts.

nodes.label: ZIP Download
nodes.description: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download/ streams a ZIP of rendered files in three subfolders: customer_uploads, mock, print.

nodes.label: Printo.in Flask Monolith
nodes.description: Flask 1.0.2 + Next.js 12.3.4 e-commerce storefront. Functionally healthy but EOL at every infrastructure layer; no security patches since 2019.

nodes.label: Printose Corporate Gifting
nodes.description: Django 2.2 + 2× Next.js 10 B2B corporate gifting / SWAG fulfillment platform. Django 2.2 EOL April 2022.

nodes.label: Estimator (In-Store POS)
nodes.description: Legacy PHP service at cs.printo.in for in-store quoting and order creation. Source not in audit scope.

nodes.label: PIA Auth & Delivery System
nodes.description: Internal auth + delivery dispatcher at pia.printo.in. De-facto integration backbone for Printose and Product Editor. Source not audited.

nodes.label: PlatformUser
nodes.description: Printo.in's single user table mixing buyers, sellers, and ops. Fragmented identity with no shared record across systems.

nodes.label: printo_integration.py
nodes.description: Flask backend code that POSTs to cs.printo.in PHP endpoints for store-pickup order handoff. No retry/backoff documented.

nodes.label: ERP Status Webhook
nodes.description: PUT /hooks/erp_status on Printo.in - Estimator calls this to update order status as its production pipeline progresses.

nodes.label: Printose → PIA Auth
nodes.description: Printose Celery tasks POST to pia.printo.in/api/v1/auth/ and /auth/refresh-token/ using a shared service account.

nodes.label: PIA Delivery Dispatch
nodes.description: POST pia.printo.in/api/v1/deliveryq/request-bulk/delivery/ used by Printose Celery tasks for bulk shipment booking.

nodes.label: Hardcoded JWT Secret Key
nodes.description: Printose ships a hardcoded SECRET_KEY in apiserver/settings.py:24 used for JWT signing - critical security risk allowing anyone with repo read access to mint admin JWTs.

nodes.label: Unified Customer Service
nodes.description: Target architecture goal: single Customer service replacing fragmented PlatformUser across Printo.in, Printose, and Product Editor.

nodes.label: Saleor Commerce Engine
nodes.description: Recommended open-source GraphQL-first commerce engine (FastAPI-based) to replace Flask monolith. Self-hostable in Mumbai.

nodes.label: Auth0 Identity (Mumbai)
nodes.description: Recommended Auth0 Mumbai region to replace Flask-Login + simplejwt + PIA for unified identity with DPDP compliance.

nodes.label: Shiprocket Logistics Aggregator
nodes.description: Recommended single logistics aggregator to replace 11 direct courier integrations (DTDC, Delhivery, Dunzo, etc.).

nodes.label: AWS SNS+SQS Event Bus
nodes.description: Recommended event bus to replace brittle point-to-point HTTP integrations between the five Printo systems.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry + Grafana Stack
nodes.description: Recommended observability stack (Tempo + Loki + Mimir) replacing 3 APMs (Sentry + NewRelic + Elastic-APM) in Printo.in.

nodes.label: DPDP Act Compliance
nodes.description: DPDP Act 2023 compliance risk: S3 bucket in Singapore (not Mumbai), no documented PII inventory across 5 systems, no unified right-to-delete.

nodes.label: Shopify POS
nodes.description: Recommended retail POS to replace legacy PHP Estimator, with hardware integrations and custom estimator UI via Shopify App.

nodes.label: Typesense Search
nodes.description: Self-hosted search engine (already in-flight at Printo.in) to replace Algolia. Open source, cheaper at scale.

nodes.label: RudderStack CDP
nodes.description: Open-source-core CDP replacing 4 disparate analytics trackers (Mixpanel + Heap + CleverTap + GA) with single pipeline.

nodes.label: Migration Roadmap
nodes.description: 12-18 month strangler-fig phasing plan with 4 phases: Foundation (4 weeks), Bridge (3 months), Storefront modernisation (6 months), Decommission (3 months).

nodes.label: GiftRecipient
nodes.description: Printose's unit-of-fulfillment model moving through 19 states. HR admin creates campaign, per-recipient slug email sent.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.description: Target architecture recommendation: extract bounded contexts behind an API gateway, run dual-mode against legacy systems during migration.

nodes.label: UI Icon Set
nodes.description: A collection of SVG icons used in the product editor frontend. All icons use a 24x24 viewBox with currentColor fill, sized at 1em for scalability.

nodes.label: Arrow Right Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon depicting a right-pointing arrow, used for navigation or directional UI cues. Renders a horizontal bar with an arrowhead pointing right.

nodes.label: Check Icon
nodes.description: SVG checkmark icon indicating confirmation, success, or selection. Commonly used in form validation, toggles, and status indicators.

nodes.label: Circle Icon
nodes.description: SVG filled circle icon, a basic geometric shape. Likely used as a radio button indicator, bullet point, or shape selector in the editor canvas.

nodes.label: Close / X Icon
nodes.description: SVG X/close icon used to dismiss dialogs, remove items, or cancel actions. Renders two diagonal lines forming a cross.

nodes.label: Heart Icon
nodes.description: SVG heart shape icon used to represent favorites, likes, or a wishlist feature. Drawn as a filled heart with a curved top.

nodes.label: Square Icon
nodes.description: SVG square/rectangle shape icon. Likely used as a shape selector or canvas element in the product editor.

nodes.label: Star Icon
nodes.description: SVG five-pointed star icon used for ratings, favorites, or decorative purposes in the product editor UI.

nodes.label: Triangle Icon
nodes.description: SVG upward-pointing triangle icon. Can represent a play button, warning indicator, or a geometric shape element in the editor.

nodes.label: Application Favicon
nodes.description: PNG favicon asset for the Next.js application, displayed in the browser tab. Part of the application branding.

nodes.label: Application Logo
nodes.description: PNG logo image for the product editor application. Used as a branding asset in the UI header or splash screen.

nodes.label: Retro Polaroid Mask (4.2x3.5)
nodes.description: A PNG mask image for a retro polaroid photo frame at 4.2x3.5 aspect ratio. Used in the overlay/mask system to apply decorative polaroid-style framing to user photos.

nodes.label: Next.js Public Assets Directory
nodes.description: The public static assets directory for the Next.js frontend, containing icons, logo, and favicon served directly as static files.

nodes.label: Storage Masks Directory
nodes.description: Server-side storage directory holding mask PNG assets used by the overlay renderer service to apply photo frame effects to product images.
